# createFolder

<link-summary>Creates a folder path in Drive, reusing the folders that already exist.</link-summary>

<web-summary>createFolder() — Creates a folder path in Drive, reusing the folders that already exist. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/drive</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function createFolder(
  path: string,
  rootFolder?: GoogleAppsScript.Drive.Folder
): GoogleAppsScript.Drive.Folder;
```

The path is walked segment by segment: an existing folder of that name is entered, a missing one is created. Drive allows two folders to share a name, so the first match wins rather than a second one being made.

## Parameters

| Parameter                 | Type                            | Description                                |
| :------------------------ | :------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------- |
| `path`                    | `string`                        | The folder path, separated by `/`.         |
| `rootFolder` _(optional)_ | `GoogleAppsScript.Drive.Folder` | Where to start. The Drive root by default. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Drive.Folder` — the folder at the end of the path.

## Examples

### In use

```javascript
const folder = createFolder("reports/2026/january");
```
